raised.claim: The exclusion list does not recognize other conventional TypeScript test paths such as `*.spec.ts` or nested `__tests__` directories, so some test bodies still consume the review context budget.
raised.why_it_breaks: For a changed reviewable file such as `src/storage/foo.spec.ts` or `src/__tests__/foo.ts`, `matchesAny` returns false, so `contextReader` reads and embeds its complete body; a large such test can consume the binding budget and demote changed source files to diff-only, preserving the failure mode this change is intended to remove.

raised.claim: The replay argument parser silently discards positional arguments beyond the documented PR number and base SHA.
raised.why_it_breaks: A command such as `npm run ai-review-replay -- 418 abc123 deadbee` succeeds while ignoring `deadbee`, so a mistyped or misplaced commit argument runs the measurement against `abc123` instead of rejecting the malformed command, potentially producing results for the wrong commit range.
